## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## How was it checked?

List relevant commands/results. For UI changes, include screenshots with synthetic or redacted data. State whether hardware or native mocks were used.

## Scope and limits

Mention firmware compatibility, provider requirements and any remaining limitations.

- [ ] Project-owned code, UI and documentation are in English.
- [ ] No keys, auth files, local configuration, private logs or conversations are included.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; third-party licenses and attribution are preserved.

For vulnerabilities, use the private reporting instructions in SECURITY.md instead of a public pull request.
